slice_definitions.swablu_eevee: Fix A, Altaria. DIAGNOSIS s1 Altaria row 4 'The Pokemon kpf feeds in front is an unevolved Swablu or Eevee ... 15 / 3 (Swablu alone 12/2)', s2 'Swablu 15/3', s3 channel 1. Rule (sk_alt_pat2.py line 125, dk='d_att'): on Altaria's own turn at the first divergence, the turn's first Zone-Energy attach goes to the Bench under kp3 and to the Active Spot under kpf (destination at attach time), and kpf's recipient is Swablu or Eevee. Identical to alt_overlap.py line 44 'B->A recipient pre-evolution'. No attack condition: 14 worse + 3 better then use Sing/Stampede; 1 worse row (kpf_attack null) does not, and the printed 15/3 includes it.
slice_definitions.forward_swap_darkrai: Fix B, Altaria's share of the pooled forward swaps 52/32 (= Altaria 4/1 + Lucario 34/24 + Vespiquen 14/7, syn_binom.py line 12). DIAGNOSIS s3 channel-2 table 'Darkrai moved up a turn early: seen in the boards, 4 / 1'. No script prints this label; the rule reproducing it exactly: kp3 Zone->Bench, kpf Zone->Active at attach time (d_att), kpf retreated before its attach, and kpf's recipient is Darkrai (sk_alt_pat2.py conditions of lines 120 and 124 combined). Same members as alt_overlap.py line 53 'Igglybuff Active, B->A, recipient Darkrai' and with d_end instead of d_att. In all 5, kp3 made no retreat that turn.

k_meaning: k = index of the first differing action line in the tick-split trace (copy 0 of the seed in both dumps, same index; verified: all earlier actions equal, same board, actor = Altaria's seat); tick = the DUMP2 tick of that line; board_own/board_opp = the shared board before the move (dump_base.txt). config = the record's run config from selected.json (all 280 Altaria records are 'first'; for the 4 seeds traced twice, classify.py's pick() takes copy 0 for 'first'). altaria_seat is not implied by config: classify.py sets it from the deal, seat 0 on an even i, seat 1 on an odd i (Altaria is the first-named deck).
denominator: 245 Altaria own-turn first divergences (123 worse, 122 better); 35 more are on the opponent's turn and are in no slice
